cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've packed extra sandwiches for your journey. You always forget to eat. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm only visiting the next town.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then they'll keep you well as long as you choose to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only because I want the last thing you hear here to be kindness.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 packed care and A3 as-long-as-you-stay create finality, but A3 authority assertion has no practical response.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 next-town limit causes A3 indefinite-stay wording; B4 calls it final and A5 openly explains last-thing-kindness.

relationship.evidence: B2 destination correction is practical, while B4 labels the mood rather than adding a need.

heightening.evidence: A5 states its own warmth-and-finality mechanism rather than enacting another kindness.

specificity.evidence: A1 travel food and B2 neighbouring town make the disproportion clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 last-thing-kindness is explicitly self-explanatory and A1 voluntary/please unnecessary.
